provenance.asset_description: Starfinder Second Edition Galactic Ancestries. The cover art features a starfinder goblin dressed in a space suit with a bandage covering a crack in their helmet, they have rocket launcher hefted to their shoulder. Standing behind them with bantrid, a short triangular alien with small wings at their back dressed in robes and glowing.
